title: Mixed Event — The Moon Rabbit & Us — Episode7 Under the Moonlit Sky

meta.Event Outline: With MORE MORE JUMP!'s next stream approaching, Shizuku starts thinking of autumn-themed ideas, triggering childhood memories of when she went moon viewing with Shiho. She invites her sister to go together once again...

rows.Line: The night of the 15th
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, this should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
You're all doing moon viewing tonight, yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I promised Tsukasa that we'd have dango together♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My mom even said that she's gonna whip up some food for us! I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can see why since your mother's such an amazing cook. She really went all out for our Doll Festival party too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But you're no slouch yourself, Honami.
What's on the menu for tonight?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...!
I'll be making dango and some dishes to go along with a traditional moon viewing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, your moon viewings sound much more interesting than what I've planned. Maybe I should consider doing a little more...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? Are you not gonna make anything, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be making dango at home, but mostly plan on just having a relaxing evening.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But that sounds lovely as well.
Enjoying the moon just the way you like seems perfect, no?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
You should spend the evening the way you like, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho? You're still here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Aren't you doing a moon viewing with your sister?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we are...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something wrong? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, nothing like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was just thinking about my sister is all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You were?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I may've mentioned this before, but she's a bit of an airhead...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I remember.
She's prone to getting lost, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. On top of that, she's terrible with electronics, has a habit of doing this sort of thousand-yard stare and can be incredibly childish at times...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I saw her working really hard on something yesterday and made a realization...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ever since we were little, she's always been there for me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whenever I felt sad or lonely, she was there to ask if anything was wrong...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She was there to comfort me without me actually realizing what she was trying to do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I said that she's childish, but me not understanding what she was doing for me sort of makes me think that I'm the child...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You love her very much, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That sounds a little too strong...
But I do think she's an incredible person.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... She's an idol, but she's also a true professional.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know she's gone through some rough patches throughout her career, but she's never not smiling when I'm with her...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's doing everything in her power to make sure she's able to spread hope to her fans.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's why I think she's so amazing.
She's peerless in that regard.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She sounds like a wonderful person...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then something crossed my mind yesterday. Maybe she's so clingy with me because it's her way of comforting me now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I really don't like it when she does that to me when we're in public since we're both high schoolers...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it may just be her way of expressing how she feels about me, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why I want to do something for her since I really haven't as far as I can tell.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think you've done quite a lot for her already.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've faced your own share of hurdles as well and managed to overcome them, right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Isn't it fair to say that your sister received some encouragement after seeing you accomplish that just as you did when you saw her working so hard?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What makes you think that...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, it's just this feeling I have based on having gotten to know you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? Just a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I get what you're trying to say, so thanks, Miku...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So Shizuku's encouraged by what I do, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's no way for me to know that for sure right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But I sort of hope that's true...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, her group's doing a stream today too, I think...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A special moon viewing stream.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I still haven't taken the time to watch one of their streams yet either...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe I should take a look...
